Ensure donor reports are prepared and submitted using the correct proposals, donor templates and formats. Coordinate multiple contributions from programme staff to donor reports. Contracting relations with partners and allies (core responsibility) Work with Movement Support Unit (MSU) head, PM and team leads to identify and agree the most critical partners and allies for sub-regional and national/sub-national convergence support and campaigns building. Work with PM and Head of MSU, as well NGOLaw, to build a standardised Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to guide relations with partners and allies. Adjust/update standard partner contract used when any funding is involved in WoMin's relationship with other organisations. Develop and maintain a schedule to ensure that reflection and relationship building conversations involving the PM, MSU lead, and team leads with partners and allies are sustained and deepened. Build tool for tracking reporting requirements as per partner contracts. Support organisational and partner due diligence and compliance processes as needed. Ensure alignment between donor grant agreements and partner sub-granting contracts where funding is involved. Support to basic data and information management Maintain and regularly update database of partners and allies per country, sub-region, Pan African and global geographies. Work alongside responsible staff to develop and update other WoMin resource and knowledge databases such as service providers and consultants. Support the maintenance, organisation and updating of organisational information alongside other responsible staff. Support the development and implementation of information management systems and processes that strengthen organisational learning. Competencies (skills, Knowledge & Abilities) Good coordination and administration skills and abilities. Good communication skills- verbal and written. Ability to multitask. Ability to work under pressure and cope with strict deadlines. Ability to work with remote programme teams. Ability to communicate with individuals from diverse backgrounds.
